description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomerOrder"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/customer-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerInformation" name="Customer information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Customer approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomerOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Potential customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SalesProcess" name="Sales / Customer Support" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerInformation" name="Customer information" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation" messageRef="Message_CustomerInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Guidance" name="Product or service guidance" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Customer approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Process customer inquiry and order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Sales">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSupport" name="Sales staff / Customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CustomerInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InquiryToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect information and address concerns or questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InquiryToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectToInterest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerInterested" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectToInterest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer in selecting a product or service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GuideToQuote</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote" messageRef="Message_Quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GuideToQuote</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_QuoteToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApproval" name="Receive customer approval" messageRef="Message_Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_QuoteToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApprovalToPlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApprovalToPlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceToRecord</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceToRecord</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecordToConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecordToConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConfirmationToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConfirmationToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InquiryToCollect" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToInterest" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerIsInterested = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="Not interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuideToQuote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuoteToApproval" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApprovalToPlaceOrder" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceToRecord" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
